name: Gazel Gode
source:
Gazel Gode is the mayor of the town of Kathtom. He's a weak man with fragile health and spends most of his time bedridden as a result.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Gazel_Gode]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
